summary: CDN dependency removed — d3@7 + dagre@0.8.5 now inlined into public/graph.html. Daemon has no generic static route (confirmed: only explicit paths; a /vendor route would need a gated daemon restart), so instead of local files I inlined the two minified libs directly, replacing the two <script src=jsdelivr> tags with inline <script> blocks. graph.html is served fresh from disk per request, so this is LIVE with no daemon restart and no interim breakage. Verified: libs contain no '</script' sequence (safe to inline); node --check on all 3 inline blocks (d3+dagre+app) = SYNTAX OK; served /graph has 0 cdn.jsdelivr refs, forceSimulation present, renderFlow/renderCloud/data-view=flow intact. graph.html grew 26KB -> 597KB (fine for localhost). Flow + Cloud now work fully offline. Note: if the daemon is ever restarted, this could be refactored to clean /vendor/*.js files + a static route, but inlining was chosen to avoid the restart gate. User: hard-reload to pick up the self-contained page.
